name: M-300 hunting blaster
description: The M-300 hunting blaster, nicknamed the "Hunting Blaster," was a long-range stun rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries to survive the rigors of the outdoors. Popular with hunters, it had unparalleled range and accuracy for its class, and due to trade-secret technologies it provided an intense and coherent blaster beam that could stun even the toughest creatures.
